name: Mars
defines: How you assert yourself — the way you pursue what you want, expend energy, and handle anger and conflict.

aries.definition: Direct, immediate force. Mars rules this sign: you go straight at the thing, and hesitation costs you more than a mistake does.
aries.showsUp: You act first and think in motion, your temper is quick and quickly spent, and you are at your best under pressure and worst when idle.

taurus.definition: Slow, immovable force. You do not start quickly, but once you are going you simply do not stop.
taurus.showsUp: You have enormous stamina, you are very hard to provoke and frightening when finally provoked, and you dig in rather than escalate.

gemini.definition: Force applied through words and manoeuvre. You win by arguing, outflanking or simply moving faster than the problem.
gemini.showsUp: You are quick and cutting in an argument, you spread your energy across several things, and you get bored before finishing what you began.

cancer.definition: Force in defence of something. You are not naturally aggressive, but you become formidable when what you care about is threatened.
cancer.showsUp: You go sideways rather than head-on, you sulk or withdraw instead of confronting, and you fight hardest on someone else's behalf.

leo.definition: Force with an audience. You want your effort to mean something and to be seen meaning it, and pride carries you a long way.
leo.showsUp: You put on a real performance when it counts, your anger is loud and theatrical rather than lasting, and you will not be made to look small.

virgo.definition: Force applied with precision. You do not push harder, you push exactly where it will work, and you prepare before you act.
virgo.showsUp: You get things done through method and persistence, your irritation comes out as criticism, and you exhaust yourself on details nobody asked for.

libra.definition: Force that hesitates. Asserting yourself sits awkwardly with your instinct to keep things even, so you negotiate where others would push.
libra.showsUp: You avoid confrontation until it has built up, you are good at arguing a case rather than having a row, and you are indirect about what you actually want.

scorpio.definition: Concentrated, strategic force. You do not spend energy casually; you wait, and then commit everything at once.
scorpio.showsUp: You are relentless once set on something, you hold anger silently rather than express it, and you never quite forget who did what.

sagittarius.definition: Force pointed at a horizon. You pursue what you believe in and lose interest in anything that does not enlarge you.
sagittarius.showsUp: You throw yourself into things wholeheartedly, your anger is loud and honest and over quickly, and you need physical freedom to stay level.

capricorn.definition: Disciplined, sustained force. Mars works well here: you set an objective and grind steadily towards it for as long as it takes.
capricorn.showsUp: You work harder than anyone and mention it less, you control your temper almost completely, and you are ruthless about what does not serve the goal.

aquarius.definition: Force in service of a principle. You act when something is wrong in the structure rather than when you personally feel slighted.
aquarius.showsUp: You resist authority reflexively, you get things done in unorthodox ways, and your anger is cold and reasoned rather than hot.

pisces.definition: Diffuse, indirect force. You do not assert yourself in a straight line, and your energy comes in tides rather than at a constant level.
pisces.showsUp: You avoid open conflict, you get your way through sympathy or evasion, and your drive rises and falls with your mood.
